question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word

Abundance
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abundance"** means a very large quantity of something;** plentifulness.** (प्रचुरता)

 
 
• **Example: **The garden was filled with an **abundance** of flowers, creating a beautiful and vibrant scene.
 
 
 
• **"Scarcity"** refers to the state of being in short supply; a situation in which something is not easy to find or obtain. (कमी)
 
 
• **Example: **During the drought, there was a **scarcity **of water in the village.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Abundance'** is **'Scarcity'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Excitement** (उत्साह): A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

 
 
• **Example:** The **excitement** in the air was palpable as the concert began.
 
 
 
• **Fortune** (भाग्य): A large amount of money or assets; luck.
 
 
• **Example: **She made her **fortune** in the stock market.
 
 
 
• **Prosperity** (समृद्धि): The state of being successful and having a lot of money.
 
 
• **Example:** The country is enjoying a period of peace and** prosperity.**
